model.name: Table of Contents
model.description:
Table of Content Widget

Widget for Figma to visualize pages as cards for index page, widget also includes statuses and descriptions for each page, very useful as a file guide for your team.


How to use:

  1. Add the widget to your Figma file.
  2. Use names without alphabetical letters to create separators between lists
  3. Use emojis at the beginning of the name of your pages to display them as an icon
  4. Click on the file description to change it.
  5. Click on status to change it to need.
  6. Enter a description for a page.


How does the icon work?

  • If the first symbols (up to 4) in the name of your file are emoji, the widget will display them separately as icons, 
  • If no emoji are used in the beginning then the widget will display the default blue icon (possible to turn it off in the property menu)


How to separate my pages?

  • If your page has no alphabetical letters (all languages are supported) then the widget will count it as a separator and will separate the cards


Property Menu:

  • Size: changing this property will configure the global scale of the widget, there are 4 sizes: extra small, small, medium, and large.
  • Theme: change the theme of the page cards, there are two options light and dark.
  • Show description: you can toggle on/off file descriptions, and descriptions for the page cards.
  • Show status: the toggle shows/hides the status in the page cards.
  • Show icon: the toggle shows icons separately or merged with the page and file name
  • Refresh: will refresh names, descriptions, and statuses, if you update it in the file or another copy of the widget in the same file.

model.name: Jira Quick Link
model.description:
This widget will automatically link to your jira issue when you click the icon. Just type the issue number into the label field. Simple!


HOW TO USE


  • Set your base URL. To find it, click on any issue in Jira, then look at the URL. Everything to the left of your ticket number should be in this field. Something like 'https://[company].atlassian.net/browse'


  • If you want to only type the number portion of your tickets, then you must include the 'common' part of your issue names within the base URL. ie. 'https://[company].atlassian.net/browse/API-'


  • Click the text to change the ticket number. You can also type a description and your issue number will be automatically extracted as long as the ticket number is in there.


  • Click the icon to open your Jira link!


  • To keep the base URL between widgets, just copy the first one rather than adding a new one.



Top Controls

  • Set Base URL - will show a field to configure your base URL. Set it once and copy the widget for subsequent issue links.


  • Dropdown #1 - changes the scale your widget renders at.


  • Dropdown #2 - changes the width of the label input field. If you have long issue numbers or want to add descriptions, you can set this higher.

model.name: Kanban Board
model.description:
Kanban Board

Link your designs, assign people, and add the due date, in this simple Kanban board.


How to use

  1. Add the widget to your Figma file.
  2. Press on the (+) icon to add a new task ticket.
  3. Enter card name.
  4. Press add card.
  5. Press on the card to add details.


What can I do with the ticket card?

  • You can change your name by clicking on the title on the card.
  • Specify a column by pressing on the dropdown with the name of the current column
  • Press on the arrow next to column selection, to instantly push your ticket to the next column
  • Specify the due date by selection the date in the date-picker
  • Assign a person by pressing on dropdown "Add assignee" list in the dropdown shows only users who opened the widget card at least once
  • Remove the ticket by pressing on the trash bin
  • Add description by pressing on the description inside the ticket itself
  • Link your design to the ticket by selecting 1 element, and pressing on the button (please note that you should select max 1 object)
  • Press on the arrow next to Linked Designs to show it in your viewport


Property Menu: 

  • Select a theme from light or dark
  • Select size from small (932px wide), medium (1864px wide), large (2796px wide)

FAQ: 

  • Q: Can I add my status column?
  • A: Not yet, however, this feature is planned, write in the comments if you would like to see this possible


  • Q: Can I do text formatting for the task description?
  • A: This feature is not planned, due to the focus to create a minimalistic simple widget for task management


  • Q: Will this widget ever have paid features?
  • A: No, this product is totally free, now and in the future

model.name: Section sorter
model.description:
Section sorter

A simple widget for Figma and FigJam to align your layers (auto-layout-like) inside your pages/sections/frames


How to:

  • Add the widget to your Figma or FigJam page
  • Place your widget inside the page/section/frame
  • Select the direction for auto alignment (horizontal or vertical)
  • Select the gap between elements
  • Press update


How does sorting work?

  • The widget sorts every element in the section/frame/page where he is located
  • Sorting order is the order of its parent (the order of layers is the order of sorting)


With what elements does it interact?

The widget works inside a page, section, or frame

And will sort and align any selection as sections, frames, groups, components, or instances; the widget will ignore any other type of element such as rectangle, sticky note, text, etc.


Property menu:

  • You can switch between a dark and light theme
  • You can show or hide Title, Emoji, Actions, Status, Description
  • You can select sorting elements as: Frame, Section, Components, Instance, Group
  • You can switch between a dark and light theme
  • You can select size (small, medium, large, extra large)
  • You can update everything


How does the icon work?

  • If the first symbols (up to 4) in the name of the widget parent are emoji, the widget will display them separately as icons,

model.description:
Goal

Easily track task status right next to mockups, prototypes, or brainstorming boards with customizable fields


HOW TO USE

  1. Add a widget to your workspace
  2. Click on the widget to display the toolbar
  3. Customize the card like u feel
  4. Add or remove cards using the toolbar
  5. Change the title text, description
  6. Change the status by clicking on it


Options (Toolbar)

  1. Show placeholder — toggle display of the image area
  2. Show description — toggle the visibility of the short description field
  3. Show status — toggle display of the task status label
  4. Show date — toggle the visibility of the date field
  5. Show details — toggle display of additional information in the upper right corner


Fields

  1. Status — a color label indicating the task status, which changes on click: To Do (yellow) → In Progress (blue) → In Review (purple) → Done (green) → To Do
  2. Details - additional editable information in the upper right corner of the card
  3. Placeholder — a square area for manually adding an icon or image via Figma
  4. Title — the main title of the task, editable field
  5. Description - a brief description of the task with multi-line input OR just link to task
  6. Date - an editable text field for the date, located in the lower right corner next to the description

  5. Link: Add external links (Jira, Docs, etc).
  6. Lock: Toggle the 🔒 icon when you're done!


Built to improve workflow organization and handoff clarity.

model.name: MindMap Pro
model.description:
🧠 MindMap Pro - Figma Community Overview


Description

MindMap Pro transforms how you brainstorm, plan, and organize ideas in Figma. Whether you're mapping out a project, organizing thoughts, or planning your next big feature, this widget makes it effortless.


Why MindMap Pro?

✨ Native to Figma - No external tools, no context switching

🎨 Beautiful by Default - 8 professional themes with auto-coloring

⚡ Lightning Fast - Instant editing, smooth interactions

🤝 Real-time Collaboration - Multiple users can edit simultaneously

📋 Smart Templates - Start fast with pre-built structures

🎯 Intuitive UX - Click twice to edit, right-click for options


Key Features


LATEST UPDATE

New Features:

- MOVE BRANCH: Reparent any non-root node by selecting it, choosing "Move Branch" from the property menu, and clicking a target node. The entire branch (node + all children) moves under the new parent. Includes safety guards to prevent cycles.


- NODE LINKS / URLS: Attach URLs to any node via "Add Link" in the property menu. A link icon appears below the node. Click the icon to place the URL on the canvas for easy copying. Edit or clear the URL anytime.

- Link copy now detects Figma's light/dark theme and places URL text in white (dark mode) or black (light mode) at 16px font size.


Improvements:

- Tree layout algorithm rewritten to calculate x positions based on actual node widths per depth level. Fixes distorted or overlapping bezier connection curves.

- Reduced horizontal and vertical spacing for a more compact, balanced tree appearance.

- Collapse/expand button (+/-) moved outside the node box for better visibility.

- Collapse/expand buttons are now white circles with dark gray icons on all node colors.

- Fixed potential duplicate ID generation that could cause node mapping issues.


---

🎨 Visual Customization

4 Node Shapes: Rectangle, Rounded, Circle, Pill

8 Professional Themes: Professional, Creative, Minimal, Warm, Cool, Sunset, Forest, Ocean

20+ Colors: Full color palette for backgrounds and text

5 Font Sizes: 12px to 20px

Bold Text: Emphasize important nodes

Auto-Color by Level: Automatic hierarchical coloring


🔗 Smart Connections

3 Connection Styles: Bezier (curved), Straight, Orthogonal

Auto-Layout: Intelligent node positioning

Collision-Free: Nodes never overlap

Dynamic Canvas: Grows automatically with your mindmap


📋 Quick Start Templates

Blank MindMap - Start from scratch

Project Planning - Phases, tasks, and resources

Brainstorming - Organize creative ideas

Decision Tree - Pros and cons analysis

Meeting Notes - Agenda, discussion, and action items


⚡ Productivity Features

Click-to-Edit: Click once to select, twice to edit

Collapse/Expand: Focus on what matters with expandable branches

Export: Export your mindmap as JSON

Keyboard-Free: Everything accessible via intuitive menus

Instant Updates: Changes reflect immediately


How to Use

Getting Started (30 seconds)

Add MindMap Pro widget to your canvas

Click the root node to select it

Right-click → "Add Child" to create branches

Click any node twice to edit text

Right-click → Choose a theme for instant styling


Creating Your Mindmap

Add Child Node: Expand your ideas hierarchically

Add Sibling Node: Create parallel branches

Edit Text: Click twice on any node

Delete Node: Right-click → Delete


Styling Your Mindmap

Change Shape: Rectangle, Rounded, Circle, or Pill

Adjust Size: 5 font size options

Bold Text: Toggle for emphasis

Colors: Choose from 20+ colors for background and text

Themes: Apply professional color schemes instantly


Organizing

Collapse Branches: Click ⊖ icon to hide children

Expand Branches: Click ⊕ icon to show children

Auto-Color: Toggle automatic color by hierarchy level

Connection Styles: Choose curved, straight, or orthogonal lines


Using Templates

Right-click on canvas background

Select "Template" → Choose a template

Your entire mindmap transforms instantly

Edit to fit your needs


Exporting

Click on canvas background (deselect nodes)

Right-click → "Export"

A text layer appears with your JSON data

Copy and save for backup or sharing


Perfect For

✅ Product Managers - Feature planning and roadmaps

✅ Designers - Design system organization

✅ Developers - Architecture planning

✅ Teams - Collaborative brainstorming

✅ Educators - Teaching and learning

✅ Writers - Story and content planning

✅ Anyone - Organizing thoughts and ideas



What Makes It Different?


vs Other Mindmap Tools

✅ Native Figma Integration - No switching between apps

✅ Real-time Collaboration - Built into Figma

✅ Beautiful Themes - Professional look instantly

✅ No Learning Curve - Intuitive from first use

✅ Free Forever - No subscriptions or limits


vs Manual Figma Frames

✅ Automatic Layout - No manual positioning

✅ Smart Connections - Lines update automatically

✅ Collapse/Expand - Manage complexity easily

✅ Themes - Consistent styling with one click

✅ Templates - Start fast with proven structures



Pro Tips

💡 Start with Templates - Save time with pre-built structures

💡 Use Themes - Get a professional look instantly

💡 Collapse Often - Keep large mindmaps manageable

💡 Click Twice to Edit - Faster than using menus

💡 Export Regularly - Backup your work as JSON

💡 Mix Shapes - Use circles for key concepts, rectangles for details

💡 Bold Important Nodes - Make hierarchy crystal clear


Technical Details

Built with: Figma Widget API, TypeScript

Layout Algorithm: Reingold-Tilford tree layout

Performance: Handles 100+ nodes smoothly

Collaboration: Full real-time multi-user support

Export Format: JSON (human-readable)


Updates & Support

This widget is actively maintained and improved based on community feedback. Found a bug or have a feature request? Let us know!


Get Started Today

Transform how you organize ideas in Figma. Add MindMap Pro to your canvas and experience the difference!


Made with ❤️ for the Figma Community
